confirm.heading: Install the orchestra in {0}?
confirm.intro: The orchestra lets AI agents work through the project's GitHub issues for you. A conductor picks issues by priority, hands them to agents working in parallel in their own copies, reviews the result and delivers it. Questions only you can answer land on the issue, not in the chat.
confirm.addsDetail: a pinned copy of the orchestra's instructions, a project policy with your rules and the /orkester command for Claude and Codex.
confirm.readmore.name: Read more about the orchestra on GitHub
confirm.readmore: Read more about the Conductor and the orchestra
confirm.summary: The chosen AI ({0}) starts in a new tab with {1}, reads the project and asks you about language, publishing and working rules before it writes the policy. Nothing is committed until you have approved.

prompt.install: Install the Conductor and the orchestra in this project. Follow INSTALL.md in https://github.com/solwation/dirigenten-och-orkestern: the latest release as a git subtree under .orchestra/shared, a project policy in .orchestra/project.md based on PROJECT.example.md, the /orkester command for Claude (.claude/commands/orkester.md) and the Codex skill (.agents/skills/orkester/SKILL.md), linked from AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Read the project first and ask me about language, publishing, capacity and timers before you write the policy. Commit once I have approved. Answer in English.

close.title: Close all
close.confirm: Active AI turns will be interrupted. Each AI then continues the latest conversation in its directory to save, commit and push completed work. Tabs close after that turn. Permissions can prevent saving. Shells and finished one-shot runs close immediately. Continue?
close.waiting: Agents are saving their work. Force close stops them immediately and can lose unsaved work. Cancel stops further closing; save turns already started may continue.
close.timeout: 10 minutes have passed. Some tabs are still open. Force close them now, or cancel and check them in the terminal.
close.noTrack: Cannot verify this tab’s process. Check the terminal manually.
close.ambiguous: Multiple tabs share this AI and directory. The latest conversation is ambiguous. Save manually, cancel or force close.
close.saveFailed: The save turn failed or was denied. Check the terminal before forcing it closed.
